newsitem.title: USA: WMX unit Q3 hurt by low recycling prices.
newsitem.headline: WMX unit Q3 hurt by low recycling prices.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc said Wednesday its Waste Mangement Inc unit's third quarter results were hurt by continuing weak prices in the markets for recyclable commodities it collects and processes.
Those weak prices particularly include paper fiber, the company's largest volume recyclable, WMX said in a news release.

"We continued to make progress on our efforts to improve our operations and delivery of services to our customers," chief executive officer Phillip Rooney said in the news release. "We are on track with our business improvement programs and we made good progress on a series of key intitiatives designed to enhance our competitive position, which we expect will reduce operating costs, increase efficiency and improve our sales and marketing capabilities."
Earlier Wednesday, WMX reported third quarter net income of $245.2 million, or $0.50 a share, compared to $233.8 million, or $0.48 a share, a year ago.
